title: Configure and verify OpenAleph tax evidence and graph screens
scope: Deliver native OpenAleph evidence search and interactive relationship exploration using FtM tax mappings, protected sources and case-scoped grants.

acceptance.text: Provision restricted synthetic collections and mapped taxpayers, companies, ownership, payment and evidence records; demonstrate search/filter, entity navigation and an interactive network diagram with source/conflict and candidate-match disclosure.

Prove collection grants implement case authorization including two different cases within one tenant, direct entity/document URLs, search and graph; native editing cannot silently overwrite authoritative originals or decisions.

Record deployed collection/entity/document/diagram navigation patterns and authentication requirements for TAX-106/109; capture configured screens, keyboard/accessibility checks; identify any unsupported behavior rather than inventing routes.
Record tests and limitations, update evidence and open a PR; do not claim native runtime readiness from fixtures.

verification: Authenticated synthetic native-screen and connected navigation checks; denied access, unavailable service and documented human visual review.
notes: Added by TAX-105 from user-requested complete frontend/native UI scope; not implemented or claimed.

notes.text: Reassigned from Leseli to Keletso (single-developer delivery, ADR-038)
